summary: North Korea ne pehli baar ek intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) ka safal parikshan kiya, jismein missile ne 2,802 kilometer ki doori tay ki aur 933 kilometer tak nishana banaya. American foreign minister Rex Tillerson ne ise "duniya ke liye ek naya khatra" bataya aur America ne United Nations Security Council ki aapat meeting bulane ki maang ki, jo 5 July ko hogi. North Korea ka ICBM KN-08 ka range 11,500 kilometer hai aur doosri missile ka range 10,000 kilometer hai.
